content.title: Enabling inflation on the Humans.ai network
content.description: The reward schedule will follow a 'Thirdening' schedule, meaning that each year the emission with decrease by 1/3 every year as opposed to the previous year. As presented on Commonwealth, inflation for the first year will be set to 12.8%. Full details about the inflation schedule can be found here: https://commonwealth.im/humansai/discussion/15071-enabling-inflation-on-the-humansai-network
